description: Voiries communautaires 20170601 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. This layer comprises all the Community roads on 1 June 2017. It is a surface layer, the geometry of the layer having the most precise delimitation possible of the Community road, set on the aerial view. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The portal shows the English title as "Community roads 20170601" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Its keywords include voirie, deplacement, cadre-de-vie, voirie-communautaire, transport, geospatial. The listing shows 6 download or service links in TXT, KML, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
